mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate trend is negative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that reduces unemployment risk and increases corporate profit expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in INDPRO and HOUST indicate robust industrial activity and consumer housing demand, generating positive equity returns as economic momentum accelerates over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST exceed their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles where FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5% and CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% annualized, rate-sensitive equities face profit margin compression, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in HOUST indicates accelerating consumer housing demand, which correlates with stronger retail sales and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST has increased over the prior 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS growth exceeding 100,000 jobs per month signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 146000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in INDPRO and RSAFS indicates expanding industrial output and real consumer sales, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both INDPRO and RSAFS exceed their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation, low-rate environments where FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized, the market anticipates aggressive rate hikes that reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.
